pattern_explanation: These Turkish words were borrowed from French and other European languages, so their spelling looks close to English. Over time, Turkish gave several of them new meanings, so the look-alike English words no longer match.
false_friend_warning: Watch out: the Turkish word that looks like 'sympathetic' means nice or pleasant in Turkish, but in English 'sympathetic' means showing understanding of someone's sadness or problems. Use 'nice' to describe a pleasant person.
